title: Care Cards And Water Protection Follow-Up
brands: Follow-up to What We Take Care Of: Card Colors And Finish and the Extras Ideas Deck (Max, Oct 18 2026 09:24-09:26 ICT). WWTCO picks: Option A is the section with every settled pick applied (own colour per card, flat white face, colour band on top, line icons, deeper shadow, underlined See All, soft chips, warm cream band, dot in the card colour; plain list rows, tight rows, no tap-for-more). Extras picks: how the winners are shown and worded.
Smart Upkeep brand: white and warm cream, terracotta, lagoon, jungle and mustard accents, Khand and Hind, light mode only.
request: Max Oct 18 2026 09:24 ICT note on Card Colors 07 Section Header: 'What do you think ?' (Branding recommends Bold Khand Title); Extras 01 note 'Maybe both ?'.
